authorization: user-authorized terminal evaluation of the frozen P3 model on the official test split of this round

P30.description: full-10k masked-SSL encoder + R3 360-epoch cosine last-5 soup, BJOC-Null 413,505 params

P31.description: full-10k masked-SSL encoder + R3 360-epoch cosine last-5 soup, BJOC-Null 413,505 params

P00.description: full-10k masked-SSL encoder + R0 240-epoch constant last-5 soup, identical architecture/init/order

P01.description: full-10k masked-SSL encoder + R0 240-epoch constant last-5 soup, identical architecture/init/order

input: official PyG ZINC subset=True split=test processed split (1000 molecules); labels guarded until the prediction freeze

preprocessing.fit: official train 10000 only; no valid/test statistics

primary_metric: raw-y single-model MAE on the official test split; P3 seed-mean = arithmetic mean of the P3 seed-0 and seed-1 single-model MAEs
primary_contrast: paired per-molecule delta d_i = 0.5*[(|e_P3s0|-|e_P0s0|) + (|e_P3s1|-|e_P0s1|)]; 95% bootstrap CI, 5000 resamples, seed 0, unit molecule

p0_replay_expectation.action_if_mismatch: STOP: report the blocker and do not claim the P3 test number is comparable

decision_rule.P3_TEST_IMPROVES: both per-seed deltas < 0 and paired bootstrap CI95 upper < 0
decision_rule.P3_TEST_WORSE: both per-seed deltas > 0 and paired bootstrap CI95 lower > 0

exposure_disclosure: official test was previously read in this project (KSVD track 2026-10-03) and by cscl-bjoc-pretraining-mechanism-terminal-test-v1; this is an exposed-test terminal evaluation, not a first blind test
